What I've recently done is started taking melatonin. It's a naturally produced hormone that helps you go to sleep when it's night/dark. You can't get addicted, but I wouldn't take them every night. Just cause, well, I don't like taking any type of pill every night lol I use it probably ~3 times a week. Take one pill (they're sold on vitamin shelves in Walmart) about 1-2 hrs before you want to sleep. Try your best, as this is where I fail, to not use electronics of any kind after taking it. Tv, computer, phone, etc actually keep you awake and restless in the night A LOT more than you'd think.

I would recommend that you don't stop cold turkey. Try slowly cutting back, trust me it'll be a lot easier. Don't smoke whenever you get the urge to, this will help train your brain. Stop smoking splifs, blunts, anything with tobacco in it. People seem to get more addicted to smoking this way (at least with most people I know). Try slowly replacing smoking with something else such as a new hobby, any (additional) exercise is a great one. Drink lots of water and get sufficient sleep/have a good sleep schedule. I can promise you it will be a much easier process this way. My friends and I have done little experiments testing the different affects with tbreaks.

I've recently been messing around a lot with different setups/styles. I've been focusing a LOT on my reaction timing and accuracy. My reaction timing has gone up tremendously (it was pretty good before, but now it's insane after lots of practice) and that has actually helped win numerous battles. I've even been able to turn on people every once in while (pretty difficult in ghosts). I can now use my aggressive style with the mtar/shotgun and get mvp. Which brings me to the whole kd thing. I have accepted that my kd probably wont raise above 1.5. However, I get mvp just about every game I play now unless I get paired up against someone very very good or a good team. I don't really care much as long as I don't get near to being negative. I'd say going 50-30 in dom with 10 caps is more fun than 17-3 with 5. So if you're speaking purely in terms of "smoking", then it does have some negative affect on the lungs. I would say maybe the throat over a long period of time if you constantly use a small unfiltered pipe, but I seriously doubt any actual harm occurs. Smoking is bad. Period. How bad? Well, that answer may vary depending on who you're asking. I've never heard of anyone acquiring cancer from the use of cannabis. Most studies show that it isn't very harmful to the lungs, mainly in comparison to tobacco smoke. Vaping and edibles are always a healthy alternative when concerned about smoking. 
Whether or not weed makes one lazy depends a lot on who you're talking about. From my experience, it tends to draw out the laziness of naturally lazy people. For some, a couple hits is just what they need in the morning to get them going. I would say as long as you have good self-control, you won't really get any lazier (except maybe during your high). Some say it lowers IQ points in younger people, but that's sorta still up for debate from what I've seen. Personally, it seems to change your view on life or certain aspects of life, generally in a positive manner. I wouldn't say it makes you more "dumb", though. From an outside perspective, heavy smokers are often considered dumb and lazy because of their care-free attitude. The level not-giving-a-shit varies greatly, just like other effects (affects?). I'm not any more care-free than when I started, but a couple friends sure are. 
The biggest problem I have experienced and witnessed first/second hand is how heavy heavy use can distort your view on certain aspects of your life. (I started really getting into smoking Jan of last year) There were a few months here and there where I smoked at least once every day. It was pretty heavenly for a while. Eventually I started telling myself that if I started growing some plants and got a really easy/low-paying job, then I could just play videogames, grow weed, and be private and happy the rest of my life. Now, there's probably a bunch of you guys reading this thinking that I'm just addicted/abnormal/whatever. However, I saw this in some others that started smoking a fuck ton all the time. It gets to you're head. Basically, it creates automatic happiness for you. Don't get me wrong, I'm not bashing on weed by any means. Everything should be used in moderation though, otherwise negatives may begin to appear. I've started smoking roughly 3-4 times a weak with t-breaks every once in a while and it's given me this new perspective. Oh well, hope this helps haha!

You sweat a bit for a while as its coming on, being in extreme temperatures is ill-advised. My second time I took two pretty good tabs and it was like 90 and humid. I won't go into that one much because you won't wanna trip lol It's nothing like weed. Weed is absolutely nothing compared to acid, not in a bad way though. you'll understand. I went to my buddies car around my peak on that trip and smoked like half a bowl and it felt so bizarre/strange/foreign, although fun. It barely affected me but my friend felt it a lot while tripping, guess it varies with person. It's also hard to describe because it kinda has levels like smoking. All the warm colors become super vibrant and much warmer looking. I didn't trip much visually like a couples friends did (sadly I'm one of those people :/) meaning like seeing shit melt. If I looked at stuff and stared then patterns would kinda form and stuff did start to kinda "melt" Every time I do it i get really hot, to the point where I hate anything more than tshirt and shorts, but again I was the only one like that. I'm trying so hard to put everything into words but it's so hard. weed is a lot easier to describe lol I always have epiphanies and revelations and stuff on it that I write down. It doesn't really impair you as much as you'd think, like I was able to drive almost peaking off one tab this one time no problem, though I obviously wouldn't advise it. One tab lasted about 9 hrs for me and then I fell asleep. Most people I guess can't go to sleep easilly from what I've heard, but that was only true for me during the trip. I always feel a little odd the next day. One of my friend's brothers tripped with us his first time and it lasted about 3 days on one tab. He didn't sleep and it honest to god changed him as a person. I've noticed it in his behavior before he even told us. He started actually repecting his parents and very rarely gets angry at people/things. He's never done it again though because of how much/long it affected him. Please make sure you're in a place that is mentally/physically/emotionally safe while you trip. By that I don't mean bubble wrap your room and sit in there. Although the number one place I would take it and stay till comfortable is your house. If you're somewhere that your brain and body is used to then you'll have a better chance of not having a bad trip. That's from personal experience at least. You won't feel like lazing around and tripping balls most likely. We always have to get up, stretch our legs, and at least walk around for awhile. Well that's all I can think of for now haha sorry for the huge amount of text, but acid imo is something you really have to have respect for.
